label: Answerability bridge versus goal-relative force for preference-independent epistemic reasons
summary: BeliefAnswerability is a universal-conditional form of the target's invariance clause (low inferential distance), stronger than needed. Ran context/dossier/related on the target. Existing Boundary goalRelative frame already shows F6, consideration presentation and the ordinary-role definition fail to exclude the goal-relative rival; accuracy certificates and the nihilism retorsion bind only subjects already taking a correctness aim. Six Lean theorem declarations are retained, with four corpus result registrations: goal-relative force plus an indifference alternative entail the target's negation; concession, answerability, goal-relativism and indifference are jointly inconsistent; goal-relative force grants the concession for aim-satisfying subjects; and finite controls separate every premise of the answerability and goal-relative exclusion arguments, give a universal-aim nonvacuity witness, and include an actually indifferent subject whose ordinary reason lacks actual force. Two retained lemmas derive the target from actual-force concession plus answerability, or from thin F6, presentation, ordinary calibration, goal-relative force and universal aim satisfaction. Their direct target registrations are deferred because the conclusion-role sense bridges misrepresented an existential as a derived sense relation; no direct graph support for the target is added. All proof bodies and frozen theorem types remain unchanged. The constitutive route excludes indifferent profiles from the comparison class; its constitutive origin is not encoded and it provides no support for the indifference case. Rejected: treating accuracy dominance or retorsion as binding indifferent profiles; an all-attitude answerability (stronger than needed); a metadata workaround that drops genuine sense uses or alters stable identities. Provisional judgment (coordinator): underdetermined; strongest objection is the attributive standard versus reason-giving distinction. Details, deferred identities, retained lemma paths and reopening conditions are in docs/notes/epistemic-authority.md. No root connection or root-premise discharge.
